name: process_step_rel
label: Table Linking Steps Between Workflows
description: The table connects the steps of the workflow and is used for querying, filtering, and reporting of workflow-related data.

fields.name: process_uuid
fields.description: Workflow UUID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: uuid
fields.description: Global unique identifier, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the UUID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_process_uuid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the process_uuid field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
